package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	d, e := sql.Open("sqlite", os.Args[1])
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	defer d.Close()
	var v string
	d.QueryRow("SELECT sqlite_version()").Scan(&v)
	fmt.Println("sqlite", v)
	for _, column := range []string{"session_id", "identity"} {
		for _, query := range []string{"DELETE FROM messages", "SELECT uuid,identity,parent_uuid,role,content,blocks_json,timestamp,is_sidechain,origin_path,origin_line,membership,payload_id FROM messages", "DELETE FROM sessions", "SELECT parent_session_id,parent_identity,cwd,COALESCE(repo_path,''),git_branch,version FROM sessions"} {
			rows, e := d.Query("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN "+query+" WHERE input_id=? AND source=? AND "+column+"=?", 1, "codex", "owner-1")
			if e != nil {
				panic(e)
			}
			for rows.Next() {
				var a, b, c int
				var detail string
				rows.Scan(&a, &b, &c, &detail)
				fmt.Println(column, query, detail)
			}
			rows.Close()
		}
	}
}
